name: ShapeRange
description: Represents a shape range, which is a set of shapes on a document. A shape range can contain as few as one shape or as many as all the shapes in the document.
remarks: You can include whichever shapes you want-chosen from among all the shapes in the document or all the shapes in the selection-to construct a shape range. For example, you could construct a ShapeRange collection that contains the first three shapes in a document, all the selected shapes in a document, or all the freeform shapes in a document. Most operations that you can do with a Shape object, you can also do with a ShapeRange object that contains only one shape. Some operations, when performed on a ShapeRange object that contains more than one shape, will cause an error. Use Range (_index_), where _index_ is the name or index number of the shape or an array that contains either names or index numbers of shapes, to return a ShapeRange collection that represents a set of shapes on a document. Use Visual Basic's Array function to construct an array of names or index numbers. The following example sets the fill pattern for shapes one and three on the active document. The following example selects the shapes named Oval 4 and Rectangle 5 on the active document.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ShapeRange object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of shapes in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Adjustments
properties.description: Returns an Adjustments object that contains adjustment values for all the adjustments in the specified ShapeRange object that represents an AutoShape or WordArt. Read-only.

properties.name: AutoShapeType
properties.description: Returns or sets the shape type for the specified ShapeRange object, which must represent an AutoShape other than a line or freeform drawing. Read/write MsoAutoShapeType.

properties.name: Callout
properties.description: Returns a CalloutFormat object that contains callout formatting properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: Fill
properties.description: Returns a FillFormat object that contains fill formatting properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: GroupItems
properties.description: Returns a GroupShapes object that represents the individual shapes in the specified group. Read-only.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of the specified shape range. Read/write Single.

properties.name: HorizontalFlip
properties.description: Indicates that a range of shapes has been flipped horizontally. Read-only MsoTriState.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the horizontal position, measured in points, of the specified range of shapes. Can also be any valid WdShapePosition constant. Read/write.

properties.name: Line
properties.description: Returns a LineFormat object that contains line formatting properties for the specified range of shapes. Read-only.

properties.name: LockAspectRatio
properties.description: MsoTrue if the specified shape retains its original proportions when you resize it. MsoFalse if you can change the height and width of the shape independently of one another when you resize it. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the specified object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Nodes
properties.description: Returns a ShapeNodes collection that represents the geometric description of the specified shape.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of degrees the specified shape is rotated around the z-axis. Read/write Single.

properties.name: PictureFormat
properties.description: Returns a PictureFormat object that contains picture formatting properties for the specified range of shapes. Read-only.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns a ShadowFormat object that represents the shadow formatting for the specified shape.

properties.name: TextEffect
properties.description: Returns a TextEffectFormat object that contains text-effect formatting properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: TextFrame
properties.description: Returns a TextFrame object that contains the text for the specified range of shapes.

properties.name: ThreeD
properties.description: Returns a ThreeDFormat object that contains 3D formatting properties for the specified range of shapes. Read-only.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical position of the specified shape or shape range in points. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the shape type. Read-only MsoShapeType.

properties.name: VerticalFlip
properties.description: True if the specified shape is flipped around the vertical axis. Read-only MsoTriState.

properties.name: Vertices
properties.description: Returns the coordinates of the specified freeform drawing's vertices (and control points for Bzier curves) as a series of coordinate pairs. Use the array returned by this property as an argument for the AddCurve or AddPolyLine method. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: True if the specified object, or the formatting applied to it, is visible. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets the width, in points, of the shapes within the range. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ZOrderPosition
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the position of the specified shape in the z-order. Read-only.

properties.name: Hyperlink
properties.description: Returns a Hyperlink object that represents the hyperlink associated with the specified ShapeRange object. Read-only.

properties.name: RelativeHorizontalPosition
properties.description: Specifies the relative horizontal position of a range of shapes. Read/write WdRelativeHorizontalPosition.

properties.name: RelativeVerticalPosition
properties.description: Specifies the relative vertical position of a range of shapes. Read/write WdRelativeHorizontalPosition.

properties.name: LockAnchor
properties.description: True if the anchor for the specified ShapeRange object is locked to the anchoring range. Read/write Long.

properties.name: WrapFormat
properties.description: Returns a WrapFormat object that contains the properties for wrapping text around the specified range of shapes. Read-only.

properties.name: Anchor
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the anchoring range for the specified shape range. Read-only.

properties.name: AlternativeText
properties.description: Returns or sets the alternative text associated with a shape in a webpage. Read/write String.

properties.name: Child
properties.description: True if the shape is a child shape or if all shapes in a shape range are child shapes of the same parent. Read-only MsoTriState.

properties.name: ParentGroup
properties.description: Returns a Shape object that represents the common parent shape of a range of shapes.

properties.name: CanvasItems
properties.description: Returns a CanvasShapes object that represents a collection of shapes in a drawing canvas.

properties.name: ID
properties.description: Returns the identification type for the range of shapes. Read-only Long.

properties.name: LayoutInCell
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents whether a shape in a table is displayed inside the table or outside the table. .

properties.name: LeftRelative
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the relative left position of a range of shapes. Read/write.

properties.name: TopRelative
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the relative top position of a range of shapes. Read/write.

properties.name: WidthRelative
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the relative width of a range of shapes. Read/write.

properties.name: HeightRelative
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the percentage of the target shape to which the range of shapes is sized. Read/write.

properties.name: RelativeHorizontalSize
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdRelativeHorizontalSize constant that represents the object to which a range of shapes is relative. Read/write.

properties.name: RelativeVerticalSize
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdRelativeVerticalSize constant that represents the object to which a range of shapes is relative. Read/write.

properties.name: SoftEdge
properties.description: Returns a SoftEdgeFormat object that represents the soft edge formatting for a range of shapes. Read-only.

properties.name: Glow
properties.description: Returns a GlowFormat object that represents the glow formatting for a range of shapes. Read-only.

properties.name: Reflection
properties.description: Returns a ReflectionFormat object that represents the reflection formatting for a range of shapes. Read-only.

properties.name: TextFrame2
properties.description: Returns a TextFrame2 object that contains the text for the specified range of shapes. Read-only.

properties.name: ShapeStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the shape style for the shapes in the specified shape range. Read/write MsoShapeStyleIndex.

properties.name: BackgroundStyle
properties.description: Sets or returns the background style of the shapes in the specified shape range. Read/write MsoBackgroundStyleIndex.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that contains a title for the shapes in the specified shape range. Read/write.

properties.name: GraphicStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoGraphicStyleIndex constant that represents the style of a shape range containing one or more SVG graphics. Read/write.

properties.name: Model3D
properties.description: Returns a Model3DFormat object that contains Model3D properties. Read-only.

properties.name: Decorative
properties.description: Sets or returns the decorative flag for the specified object. Read/write.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual Shape object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position or a String representing the name of the individual object.

methods.name: Align
methods.signature: Align(Align As MsoAlignCmd, RelativeTo As Long)
methods.description: Aligns the shapes in the specified range of shapes.

parameters.name: Align
parameters.description: Specifies the way the shapes in the specified shape range are to be aligned.

parameters.name: RelativeTo
parameters.description: True to align shapes relative to the edge of the document. False to align shapes relative to one another.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies to the specified shape formatting that has been copied using the PickUp method.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified range of shapes.

methods.name: Distribute
methods.signature: Distribute(Distribute As MsoDistributeCmd, RelativeTo As Long)
methods.description: Evenly distributes the shapes in the specified range of shapes. .

parameters.name: Distribute
parameters.description: Specifies whether to distribute shapes horizontally or vertically.

parameters.name: RelativeTo
parameters.description: True to distribute the shapes evenly over the entire horizontal or vertical space on the page. False to distribute them within the horizontal or vertical space that the range of shapes originally occupies.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the specified ShapeRange object, adds the new range of shapes to the Shapes collection at a standard offset from the original shapes, and then returns a Shape object.

methods.name: Flip
methods.description: Flips a shape horizontally or vertically.

parameters.name: FlipCmd
parameters.description: The flip orientation.

methods.name: IncrementLeft
methods.description: Moves the specified shape horizontally by the specified number of points.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shape is to be moved horizontally, in points. A positive value moves the shape to the right; a negative value moves it to the left.

methods.name: IncrementRotation
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the z-axis by the specified number of degrees. .

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shape is to be rotated horizontally, in degrees. A positive value rotates the shape clockwise; a negative value rotates it counterclockwise.

methods.name: IncrementTop
methods.description: Moves the specified shape vertically by the specified number of points.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shape object is to be moved vertically, in points. A positive value moves the shape down; a negative value moves it up.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Groups the shapes in the specified range, and returns the grouped shapes as a single Shape object.

methods.name: PickUp
methods.description: Copies the formatting of the specified shape.

methods.name: ScaleHeight
methods.signature: ScaleHeight(Factor As Single, RelativeToOriginalSize As MsoTriState, [Scale As MsoScaleFrom])
methods.description: Scales the height of a range of shapes by a specified factor.

parameters.name: Factor
parameters.description: Specifies the ratio between the height of the shape after you resize it and the current or original height. For example, to make a rectangle 50 percent larger, specify 1.5 for this argument.

parameters.name: RelativeToOriginalSize
parameters.description: True to scale the shape relative to its original size. False to scale it relative to its current size. You can specify True for this argument only if the specified shape is a picture or an OLE object.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: The part of the shape that retains its position when the shape is scaled.

methods.name: ScaleWidth
methods.signature: ScaleWidth(Factor As Single, RelativeToOriginalSize As MsoTriState, [Scale As MsoScaleFrom])
methods.description: Scales the width of a shape by a specified factor.

parameters.name: Factor
parameters.description: Specifies the ratio between the width of the shape after you resize it and the current or original width. For example, to make a rectangle 50 percent larger, specify 1.5 for this argument.

parameters.name: RelativeToOriginalSize
parameters.description: True to scale the shape relative to its original size. False to scale it relative to its current size. You can specify True for this argument only if the specified shape is a picture or an OLE object.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: The part of the shape that retains its position when the shape is scaled.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects the specified range of shapes.

parameters.name: Replace
parameters.description: If adding a shape, True replaces the selection. False adds the new shape to the selection.

methods.name: SetShapesDefaultProperties
methods.description: Applies the formatting of a default shape for a document to the specified range of shapes.

methods.name: Ungroup
methods.description: Ungroups any grouped shapes in the specified range of shapes, disassembles pictures and OLE objects within the specified shape or range of shapes, and returns the ungrouped shapes as a single ShapeRange object.

methods.name: ZOrder
methods.description: Moves the specified shape range in front of or behind other shapes in the collection (that is, changes the shape range's position in the z-order).

parameters.name: ZOrderCmd
parameters.description: Specifies where to move the specified shape range relative to the other shapes.

methods.name: ConvertToInlineShape
methods.description: Converts the specified shape in the drawing layer of a document to an inline shape in the text layer. You can convert only shapes that represent pictures, OLE objects, or ActiveX controls. .

methods.name: CanvasCropLeft
methods.description: Crops a percentage of the width of a drawing canvas from the left side of the canvas.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: The amount in percentage points of the drawing canvas's width that you want remaining after the canvas is cropped. Entering 0.9 as the increment crops ten percent of the canvas's width from the left. Entering 0.1 crops ninety percent of the canvas's width from the left.

methods.name: CanvasCropTop
methods.description: Crops a percentage of the height of a drawing canvas from the top of the canvas.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: The amount in percentage points of a canvas's height that you want remaining after the canvas is cropped. Entering 0.9 as the increment crops ten percent of the canvas's height from the top. Entering 0.1 crops ninety percent of the canvas's height from the top.

methods.name: CanvasCropRight
methods.description: Crops a percentage of the width of a drawing canvas from the right side of the canvas.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: The amount in percentage points of the canvas's width that you want remaining after the canvas is cropped. Entering 0.9 as the increment crops ten percent of the canvas's width from the right. Entering 0.1 crops ninety percent of the canvas's width from the right.

methods.name: CanvasCropBottom
methods.description: Crops a percentage of the height of a drawing canvas from the bottom of the canvas.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: The amount in percentage points of a drawing canvas's height that you want remaining after the canvas is cropped. Entering 0.9 as the increment crops ten percent of the canvas's height from the bottom. Entering 0.1 crops ninety percent of the canvas's height from the bottom.
